## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, your change and any related issue.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Changes include regression coverage where behavior changed.
- [ ] Any sample files use synthetic data.

For interface changes, include screenshots and describe checks for keyboard use, narrow layouts and the affected comparison flow.

## Compatibility and limitations

Mention any change to comparison rules, file support, limits, privacy behavior or bundled dependencies.
